VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify that acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 64 tests pass and describes the fix in detail, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 64 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof rather than assertion. Self-reports are the weakest admissibility class and cannot establish objective test results without supporting documentation.
